defaults.title: UNBLOCKED — Question Everything
defaults.description: The systems around us shape how we live. What we own. What we keep. How we use energy. How we relate to one another. These are shared questions, open to different interpretations.

image.alt: UNBLOCKED in large black letters on blue, with pink labels: Dialogue & Creative Expression, Exploring (Hidden) Systems

/posters.title: Ownership Poster Contest — UNBLOCKED
/posters.description: Ownership poster contest, 21.02.26—23.09.26. UNBLOCKED seeks provocative poster work that challenges the everyday. Everyone is invited.

/guidelines.title: Submission Guidelines — UNBLOCKED
/guidelines.description: This page explains how to prepare and submit work for the poster contest. The first theme is Ownership.

/grants.title: Residency & Grant Programs for Creatives — UNBLOCKED
/grants.description: We back artists, designers, filmmakers, and writers who make the hidden systems shaping our lives visible—and imagine how they could work differently.

/grants/culture-grants.title: Culture Grants — UNBLOCKED
/grants/culture-grants.description: One-time money from $500 to $5000 for public work on our four themes. Make a focused piece, show it or document it, and it joins the UNBLOCKED archive and published in our book.

/grants/open-systems.title: Open Systems Application Support — UNBLOCKED
/grants/open-systems.description: We prepare the application for Spiral. They fund 12-month design and experience work on open money and open intelligence.
